t_advice_summary_textbox.text: One side has a higher mushroom count, if it changes to x5 stay on that side, if it changes to x1 move to the other side. If it stays as x1 swap sides, if it stays as x5 don't swap sides

vb_textbox.text: Work out the gnome with the highest number of mushrooms. Once you have if a x5 comes up, stay on that side. If a x1 comes up, change sides.
